decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to quickly deploy aggressive threats such as Brazen Borrower, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Wasteland, allowing the aggressive creatures to close out the game. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Preordain to maintain card advantage and find the necessary pieces to execute its game plan efficiently.

This deck focuses on rapidly setting up a combo using Doomsday to win the game. It utilizes cards like Dark Ritual and Cabal Ritual to generate mana quickly, while also including cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to set up the perfect hand for Doomsday. Thassa's Oracle is used as the win condition, along with Tendrils of Agony as a backup. The deck includes disruption spells like Duress and Thoughtseize to protect the combo, and lands that provide the necessary colors of mana for the spells. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to secure a win.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to quickly disrupt opponents and apply pressure using aggressive creatures such as Pyrogoyf and Magus of the Moon, while also utilizing powerful cards like Chalice of the Void and The One Ring to control the battlefield. The deck aims to lock opponents out of casting spells with disruptive elements like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon, while also providing direct damage and removal spells like Shatterskull Smashing and Sundering Eruption to maintain control of the game. The mana base of City of Traitors, Ancient Tomb, and Mountain ensures fast and consistent casting of spells.

The main concept of this deck is to control the opponent through counterspells and removal spells, while using cards like Phyrexian Dreadnought and Curie, Emergent Intelligence to put pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to stifle the opponent's strategies while efficiently controlling the board with cards like Doorkeeper Thrull and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The deck also utilizes cards like Lotus Petal and Urza's Saga to ramp up and generate card advantage. Overall, the deck focuses on maintaining control of the game and overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats.

The main idea of this deck is to combo off using Mystic Forge and various artifact cards such as Basalt Monolith, Voltaic Key, and Grim Monolith to generate infinite mana and cast spells from the top of the library. Tezzeret, Cruel Captain and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional utility and ways to search for key pieces. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Portable Hole and Soul-Guide Lantern while setting up its combo pieces. With strong ramp from cards like Lotus Petal and Urza lands, the deck can assemble its combo quickly and overwhelm opponents.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize combo pieces like Nadu, Winged Wisdom and Nomads en-Kor along with protection and card manipulation spells to create a powerful and resilient combo engine. By using cards like Brainstorm, Force of Will, and Green Sun's Zenith, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and control the game while setting up for a decisive win. The deck also includes some strategic land choices like Karakas and Dryad Arbor to further enhance its versatility and resilience in different matchups.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and then bring them back into play using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo and control the opponent's plays. With a mix of control and reanimation elements, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while disrupting their game plan.

The main objective of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creature cards, such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize. By utilizing Reanimate and Animate Dead, these creatures can be brought back to the battlefield without paying their mana cost. This combo-based strategy aims to overwhelm the opponent with high-impact creatures early in the game, while also utilizing control elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo pieces. The deck also includes card draw and mana fixing to ensure consistency and efficiency.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through ramping up mana with Cloudpost and Tron lands to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog. It also utilizes disruptive artifacts like Karn's Sylex and Soul-Guide Lantern to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes cards like Crop Rotation and Once Upon a Time to help find key lands or spells at the right time. Karn, the Great Creator is used to search for important artifacts from the sideboard, while Ugin, Eye of the Storms provides additional control and removal options.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and card advantage. It utilizes powerful cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding to disrupt opponents' strategies, while also generating value through cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Quantum Riddler. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional card advantage and flexibility in longer games. The deck also includes a mix of lands to ensure consistency and mana fixing. By effectively managing resources and disrupting opponents, the deck aims to outlast and outvalue its opponents.

The main concept of this Bant Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy and control the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The deck uses cards like Force of Will, Force of Negation, Swords to Plowshares, and Supreme Verdict to handle threats, while also using cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for answers. The deck also includes powerful threats like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Endurance to apply pressure and generate value. Overall, the deck aims to maintain a strong board presence while controlling the pace of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to control the tempo of the game by using disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Daze to disrupt your opponent's strategy while deploying threats like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. The deck also utilizes powerful spells like Fatal Push and Force of Will to deal with threats efficiently. The mana base of the deck is optimized to ensure smooth gameplay and access to all colors of mana needed for its spells.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of Nomads en-Kor and Nadu, Winged Wisdom to draw and play an infinite number of cards in a single turn, overwhelming the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo, along with control elements like Swords to Plowshares and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the game state. The deck aims to be fast and efficient, utilizing mana acceleration from Noble Hierarch and ramp creatures like Plagon, Lord of the Beach to quickly set up the combo.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures, using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm to set up the combo. It then utilizes Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring back these creatures from the graveyard for a big swing. The deck also includes disruption cards like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and control the opponent's plays. The mana base is optimized for consistency and includes lands that can disrupt the opponent's mana base, such as Wasteland. Overall, the deck aims to win quickly through powerful combos and graveyard recursion.

The main concept of this deck is to consistently and quickly reanimate powerful creatures from the graveyard, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and hand disruption. The deck aims to use cards like Entomb and Reanimate to put creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play early, overwhelming the opponent before they have a chance to respond. With a combination of efficient threats and disruption spells, this deck looks to close out games quickly through a powerful combo strategy.

This Legacy Aggro-Maverick deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures and disruptive spells to pressure opponents and disrupt their gameplan. The deck includes cards like Thoughtseize and Endurance to disrupt opponents, along with creatures like Wight of the Reliquary and Elvish Reclaimer to apply pressure and search for key lands. Green Sun's Zenith and Gaea's Cradle help ramp up the mana production for big plays, while cards like Once Upon a Time and Collector Ouphe provide additional utility and flexibility in different situations. This deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver opponents with a mix of aggression and disruption.

The primary strategy of this deck is to quickly control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan with a combination of efficient removal spells and counter magic, while deploying threats that can close out the game quickly. The deck utilizes a combination of disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will, along with efficient creatures like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo advantage throughout the game by constantly disrupting the opponent's plays and developing its own board presence.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through the use of lands and disruptive spells. The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Mox Diamond and Life from the Loam to generate mana and recur crucial lands. It also aims to disrupt the opponent's strategies with cards like Wasteland and Pithing Needle. The deck ultimately aims to win by creating a powerful threat with Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage, while maintaining control over the game with cards like The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale and Maze of Ith.

This deck focuses on utilizing lands as both resources and control elements, leveraging cards like Exploration, Crop Rotation, and Life from the Loam to manipulate the board and generate value. The deck aims to assemble the Dark Depths-Thespian's Stage combo to create a powerful 20/20 Indestructible creature, while also disrupting opponents with cards like Ghost Quarter and Boseiju, Who Endures. Overall, this deck seeks to control the game through strategic land plays and resource management, ultimately outlasting and outmaneuvering the opponent.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo with cards like Intuition, Echo of Eons, and Mind's Desire to generate a massive amount of card advantage and mana acceleration. The goal is to quickly ramp up mana with Grim Monolith and Lotus Petal, while utilizing cards like Candy Trail and Stock Up to control the board. Tezzeret, Cruel Captain provides additional card advantage and utility, while cards like Defense Grid and Lion's Eye Diamond help protect and enable the combo. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with explosive plays and efficient mana usage.

This deck focuses on utilizing Mystic Forge to combo off and generate massive amounts of mana through cards like Grim Monolith and The One Ring. The goal is to assemble a board state that allows you to play out your entire deck in a single turn, eventually leading to a win condition with cards like Glaring Fleshraker or Planar Nexus. Karn, the Great Creator and Tezzeret, Cruel Captain provide additional utility and support for the combo strategy. The deck relies heavily on artifacts and mana acceleration to quickly set up its game-winning plays.

This deck focuses on using Mystic Forge as a key piece to generate value and combo off with other artifacts. By utilizing cards like Basalt Monolith, Grim Monolith, Voltaic Key, and Manifold Key, the deck can create infinite mana loops and chain together spells from the top of the library with Mystic Forge. The deck also includes various utility artifacts like Pithing Needle, Soul-Guide Lantern, and Karn, the Great Creator to disrupt opponent's strategies. With powerful cards like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Tezzeret, Cruel Captain, the deck aims to control the game and assemble its combo pieces for a win.

This deck aims to utilize the Mystic Forge and various artifact cards to power out powerful combos and lock down the opponent with Defense Grid. It focuses on generating mana quickly with cards like Grim Monolith and Lotus Petal, while also taking advantage of cards that can untap and manipulate artifacts like Manifold Key and Voltaic Key. The goal is to quickly assemble key pieces like Urza's Saga and The One Ring to create a dominating board state and overwhelm the opponent with powerful artifacts and combos.

This deck utilizes artifacts to generate infinite mana through card synergies and untapping effects, allowing the player to cast spells from the top of their library with Mystic Forge. The key combo pieces include Mystic Forge, Basalt Monolith, Grim Monolith, Voltaic Key, and Candelabra of Tawnos. The deck aims to establish a strong mana base with Urza lands and Ancient Tomb to power out powerful plays and lock opponents out using disruptive cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Eye of the Storms. The win condition often involves overwhelming the opponent with massive spells or creatures created using the infinite mana combo.

This deck aims to quickly assemble a combo involving Nomads en-Kor and either Allosaurus Shepherd or Endurance to enable a quick win condition. Nadu, Winged Wisdom serves as the key piece in this combo, allowing for card draw and strong synergy with the rest of the deck. The deck includes various utility creatures and spells to support the combo strategy, as well as a strong mana base to ensure consistency in executing the combo. Overall, the deck focuses on using efficient creatures and spells to set up a powerful, game-winning combo.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize fast mana acceleration and card draw to quickly build up storm count and cast spells to ultimately win the game with Tendrils of Agony. The deck runs a combination of rituals, fast mana rocks, and discard spells to enable explosive turns and generate a critical mass of spells to storm off. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and Beseech the Mirror provides additional consistency and ability to search for key pieces to set up the storm win condition.

The main focus of this combo-reanimator deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then bring them back onto the battlefield using Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo pieces, as well as card draw and selection spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to help find key cards. With the ability to quickly reanimate threats like Archon of Cruelty and Murktide Regent, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure victory.

This deck focuses on fast-paced aggression and control using efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Force of Will, while also utilizing disruptive cards like Brazen Borrower and Stifle. Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent provide powerful threats that can quickly close out games. The mana base is designed for consistency and includes powerful lands like Wasteland. The deck aims to control the board and push through damage quickly to overwhelm opponents before they can establish their own game plan.
